verdict.rationale: LocalAI documents a prebuilt Docker image (`docker run ... localai/localai:latest`) that installs without compiling. It describes itself as 'one binary' and auto-downloads the right prebuilt backend for the detected GPU. However, no evidence documents downloadable release binaries, OS packages, package-manager installs or an install script, so the 'binaries or packages' part is only implied. missing for 10: documented prebuilt binary downloads per OS/arch, package-manager or install-script options, independent or hands-on corroboration of non-source installs

support.subject: As a developer, I can install using prebuilt binaries or packages instead of compiling from source

citations.quote: One binary with an OpenAI-compatible API in front of it.
LocalAI automatically detects your system's GPU capabilities (NVIDIA, AMD, Intel) and downloads the appropriate backend.
